title: Developer Velocity Labs: Experimentation Roadmap & Initiative Hub for SDKs/Quickstarts
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Establish a repeatable initiative hub (Developer Velocity Labs) to track and operationalize experiments across SDKs, docs, and quickstarts. The goal is to correlate experimental changes (e.g., API surface tweaks, onboarding flows, code samples) with activation, time-to-first-success, and retention signals. Deliverables: 1) canonical experiment template and tracking contract, 2) experiment slate and quarterly roadmap, 3) dashboards for activation/retention/quality attribution, 4) playbook for rolling winners into the main SDK product and docs. This ticket coordinates PM scope: roadmap, OKR mapping, prioritization, stakeholder sign-offs, and handoff to engineering and design for execution.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment template (Confluence) created and approved by PM + Eng + Design
Quarterly slate prioritized and committed with owners for each experiment
A/B or incremental rollout plan drafted for top 3 experiments
Dashboards exist in Looker with attribution to SDK versions and quickstart variants
Clear criteria defined for promoting experiments to product (pass/fail thresholds)
progress_updates: 2025-11-12: Kickoff meeting with Eng (runtime + SDK), Design, and Analytics. Aligned on metrics: activation (first successful call),-api-error-rate, time-to-complete-quickstart.

2025-11-20: Drafted experiment template. Feedback from Design: add UX success criteria and required mock links. Feedback from Analytics: include event naming conventions (sdk.install, sdk.first_call).
2025-11-28: Prioritized initial slate of 7 experiments (focus: onboarding microflows, sample app templates, streaming SDK defaults). Assigned owners and preliminary signals for each experiment.
2025-12-02: Eng flagged dependency ENG-20345 (SDK telemetry middleware) — blocked one experiment until middleware prototype is merged. Assigned to ENG-20345 owner for expedited work.
2025-12-07: Created Looker dashboard skeleton and wired basic activation metric. Need mapping of PR IDs to experiment slugs for attribution (action item for analytics).
2025-12-08: PM review with Director: OKR mapping approved (see OKR mapping doc). Next: finalize experiment contract and schedule canary runs for Jan cycle.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Lack of SDK telemetry limits attribution. Mitigation: prioritize ENG-20345 middleware and add server-side fallbacks for attribution.
Risk: Design bandwidth constrained for high-fidelity variants. Mitigation: start with low-fidelity A/B and reserve two experiments for full-design support.
Risk: Promotion criteria unclear may delay rollouts. Mitigation: define pass/fail thresholds in the template and require pre-commit signoff.
decisions: Use experiment slugs (devx-labs-<n>) as canonical IDs across Confluence, GitHub PRs, and Looker to avoid mismatch.
Adopt sample app 'starter-lite' as the canonical quickstart variant for initial experiments to reduce surface area.
Prioritize telemetry-first experiments that can be measured without backend schema changes where possible.
review_feedback: Design (Maya Rao): add success flows and wireframes for the three onboarding experiments; prefer progressive disclosure pattern.
Engineering (Samir Patel): requested explicit engineering acceptance criteria for rollout (feature flag, telemetry events, fallback behavior).
Analytics (Jordan Lee): recommended event naming and minimum sample sizes for statistical tests; suggested ramp plan for canary percentages.
next_steps: Finalize experiment template and publish to Confluence (owner: Ava)
Unblock ENG-20345 telemetry middleware and track PRs to readiness (owner: Samir)
Complete Looker attribution wiring and map experiment slugs to PRs (owner: Jordan)
Schedule Jan canary runs and reserve dedicated monitoring rotations during canaries (owner: Liam)
